test_is_null_followed_by_all: test the LazyFrame optimization that replaces is_null().all() with null_count() == len()
test_is_null_followed_by_any: test the LazyFrame optimization that replaces is_null().any() with null_count() > 0
test_is_not_null_followed_by_any: test the LazyFrame optimization that replaces is_not_null().any() with null_count() < len()
test_drop_nulls_followed_by_len: test the LazyFrame optimization that replaces drop_nulls().len() with len() - null_count()
test_collapse_joins: test the LazyFrame optimizer that collapses cross joins with filters into inner or IE joins
